Not console-tested. | 2026-10-17 second pass (FINDINGS 6v): from 1288aca2, sceKernelGetAppInfo2 and sceKernelTitleWorkaroundIsEnabled2 (from 6.00; inputs of the MFSR2 override) restored from local definitions to imports with the former stub as GOT pre-fill (fakelib restore-imports). Not console-tested.
